mapper.select: -- 선택 연도 기준 사업본부별 연간 매출 목표를 조회한다. SELECT art.annual_revenue_target_id, CAST(#{businessYear} AS INTEGER) AS business_year, d.department_id, d.code AS department_code, d.name AS department_name, d.display_order, COALESCE(art.target_amount, 0) AS target_amount FROM departments d LEFT JOIN annual_revenue_targets art ON art.department_id = d.department_id AND art.business_year = #{businessYear} WHERE d.is_active = TRUE ORDER BY d.display_order, d.department_id
-- 활성 사업본부 존재 여부를 조회한다. SELECT COUNT(1) FROM departments d WHERE d.department_id = #{departmentId} AND d.is_active = TRUE
mapper.insert: -- 사업본부별 연간 매출 목표를 등록 또는 수정한다. INSERT INTO annual_revenue_targets ( business_year, department_id, target_amount, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{businessYear}, #{departmentId}, #{targetAmount}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserId} ) ON CONFLICT (business_year, department_id) DO UPDATE SET target_amount = EXCLUDED.target_amount, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = NOW()
